hints.title: Repeated Prefix Sums
hints.text: Repeated prefix summation generates binomial coefficients along diagonal entries.

hints.title: Combinations Formula
hints.text: The n-th value after k seconds equals comb(n + k - 1, k) modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Modular Arithmetic
hints.text: Compute comb(n + k - 1, k) modulo 10^9 + 7 using modular inverse.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import math

class Solution:
    def valueAfterKSeconds(self, n: int, k: int) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        return math.comb(n + k - 1, k) % MOD
```

complexity.notes: Combinations calculated via arithmetic multiplication and modular inverse.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n * k) array updating is acceptable but slower than direct formula.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the connection between iterated prefix sums and binomial coefficients.
